settings.text: Kiggle was founded with a deep commitment to children, their future, and our planet. Based in Kolkata, India, our mission is to create comfortable, sustainable, and genderless clothing using organic cotton, designed for environmentally conscious parents. Our founders, devoted parents themselves, envisioned a brand that combines quality and care, going beyond fast fashion. Every piece reflects our dedication to making childhood simpler and the world better.

How Kiggle Started

We started kiggle because we couldn’t find the kind of kids clothes we wanted for our kids that were soft, safe and made with care Most options were either too rough, not breathable, or full of chemicals. As parents, It Didn’t Feel Right.

That’s when we decided to take matters into our own hands. And that’s how Kiggle was born a small, homegrown label started by parents who simply wanted something better for their kids and yours.

settings.heading: Designed with Real Kids in Mind

settings.text: Everything at Kiggle is created with everyday childhood in mind the scraped knees, the muddy shoes, the never-sit-still energy. Based out of Kolkata, we focus on making practical, comfortable clothes using GOTS-certified organic cotton. That means it’s soft, breathable, and safe for delicate skin, and a little kinder to the Earth too.
We don’t follow trends. Instead, we stick to simple, timeless designs that can be worn by any child, no matter their style, mood, or adventure.
We believe kids should feel free to be themselves to run around, get messy, and enjoy being little. Clothes should support that kind of freedom, not get in the way.
Our goal is simple: to make sustainable, easygoing clothing that’s safe, gentle, and made to handle all the moments big or small that make up childhood.
We also want to make life easier for parents by offering quality you can trust.

settings.title: Shubham Kasera
settings.text:
CEO

Shubham leads Kiggle with a perfect mix of creativity and business sense. Before Kiggle, he built a successful menswear label and even trained as a cinematographer—skills that fuel his out-of-the-box thinking. When he's not steering the company, Shubham’s busy being a fun, hands-on dad to his energetic 3-year-old.

settings.title: Adity Dokania
settings.text:
CTO

Adity is the tech genius driving Kiggle forward, with deep expertise from her work at Kensho, a top-tier Boston tech firm. Known for her passion for innovation, she’s always looking for creative ways to push the envelope. When she’s not solving complex tech challenges, Adity is all about family time, especially with her curious and playful 2-year-old.

settings.text:
CFO

Vineet is the financial architect behind Kiggle’s strategic growth. With years of experience as a commodity trader in Indonesia, he’s skilled at balancing risk and reward. But numbers aren’t his only focus—Vineet is a proud father who loves spending quality time with his adventurous 3-year-old.
